from pathlib import Path
import re
from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
files=[Path('README.md'),Path('tests/statement/README.md'),Path('tests/statement/results/README.md'),Path('tests/statement/results/harness-vs-direct/README.md')]
count=0
for file in files:
 text=re.sub(r'```.*?```','',file.read_text(),flags=re.S)
 for target in re.findall(r'(?<!!)\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)',text):
  target=target.strip('<>')
  if urlsplit(target).scheme or target.startswith('#'):continue
  dest=(file.parent/unquote(target.split('#',1)[0])).resolve()
  assert dest.exists(),f'{file}: missing {target}'
  count+=1
print(f'PASS: {count} local Markdown link targets across {len(files)} documentation files')
PY
